Package org.drip.regression.nonlinear

Non-linear Least Squares Regression
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    GaussNewton
    GaussNewton implements the Non-linear Least-Squares Regression using the Gauss-Newton Algorithm.
    GaussNewtonIterationDiagnostics
    CalibratedParameters holds the Results of a Least-Squares Calibration Run.
    GaussNewtonRun
    GaussNewtonRun holds the Results of a Gauss-Newton Least-Squares Calibration Run.
    GaussNewtonRunDiagnostics
    GaussNewtonRunDiagnostics holds the Results of a Gauss-Newton Least-Squares Calibration Diagnostic Run.
    ImplicitTrustRegion
    ImplicitTrustRegion holds the Implicit Trust Regions used in Non-linear Least Squares Regression.
    MichaelisMentenParametric
    MichaelisMentenParametric implements the Parametric FOrm of the MichaelisMenten Model.
    R1R1Sample
    R1R1Sample holds the Sample of (R1, R1) Realizations.
    R1ToR1Parametric
    R1ToR1Parametric abstracts the Calibratable R1 to R1 Function.
    R1ToR1Residual
    R1ToR1Residual holds the Residual corresponding to a (x, y) Pair for a given Parameterized Objective Function.
